title_sq: Okazion!!Ne Don Bosko,Tek Kompleksi Manhatan, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideal Per Investim!!
description_sq: Okazion!! Ne Don Bosko, Tek Kompleksi Manhatan Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideal Per Investim ,i Pozicionuar Me Pamje Nga Rruga Kryesore !!! Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 100.56 m2 dhe ndodhet ne katin e 5-te te nje residence 31-kateshe, ne fazen fillestare te ndertimit. Eshte i organizuar nga korridori i cili ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes dhe kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon , nje dhome matrimoniale po ashtu me dalje ne ballkon dhe nje tualet .Orientimi i apartamentit jug ben qe te kete diell pjesen me te madhe te dites. Disa nga benefitet e kompleksit jane: fasade e ventiluar me termoizolim dhe izolim akustik ; dritare me dopio xham me mbushje me gaz; Pallati eshte i lokalizuar ne rruge kryesore, ka akses ne transport publik dhe afersi me bankat, institucionet.
title_en: Opportunity!! In Don Bosco, at the Manhattan complex, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!
description_en: Opportunity!! In Don Bosco, at the Manhattan complex, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment, positioned with a view from the main street!!! The apartment has a total area of ​​100.56 m2 and is located on the 5th floor of a 31-story residence, in the initial phase of construction. It is organized by the corridor which divides it into the living room and the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a matrimonial room also with access to the balcony and a toilet. The orientation of the apartment to the south makes it sunny most of the day. Some of the benefits of the complex are: ventilated facade with thermal insulation and acoustic insulation; gas-filled double-glazed windows; The building is located on the main road, has access to public transport and is close to banks and institutions.
